from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Dict, List, Any, Optional, Tuple


class MediaRepository(ABC):
    """Abstract interface for media operations."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def save_file(self, media: Any) -> Tuple[bool, int]:
        """Save a media file. Returns (success, status_code)."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_search_results(
        self, query: str, file_type: Optional[str] = None, max_results: int = 10, offset: int = 0, filter: bool = True
    ) -> Tuple[List[Any], int, int]:
        """Search for media files. Returns (results, next_offset, total_results)."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_file_details(self, query: str) -> List[Any]:
        """Get details for a specific file_id."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def ensure_indexes(self) -> None:
        """Ensure required database indexes exist."""
        pass


class UserRepository(ABC):
    """Abstract interface for user operations."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def add_user(self, user_id: int, name: str) -> None:
        """Add a new user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def is_user_exist(self, user_id: int) -> bool:
        """Check if a user exists."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def total_users_count(self) -> int:
        """Return total number of users."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def ban_user(self, user_id: int, ban_reason: str = "No Reason") -> None:
        """Ban a user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def unban_user(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        """Unban a user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_banned(self) -> Tuple[List[int], List[int]]:
        """Return banned users and disabled chats."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def remove_ban(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        """Remove ban for a user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_ban_status(self, user_id: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get ban status for a user."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_all_users(self) -> Any:
        """Get all users cursor."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def delete_user(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        """Delete a user."""
        pass


class ChatRepository(ABC):
    """Abstract interface for chat/group operations."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def add_chat(self, chat_id: int, title: str) -> None:
        """Add a new chat."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_chat(self, chat_id: int) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Get chat details."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def disable_chat(self, chat_id: int, reason: str = "No Reason") -> None:
        """Disable a chat."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def re_enable_chat(self, chat_id: int) -> None:
        """Re-enable a disabled chat."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_all_chats(self) -> Any:
        """Get all chats cursor."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def total_chat_count(self) -> int:
        """Return total number of chats."""
        pass


class SettingsRepository(ABC):
    """Abstract interface for settings operations."""

    @abstractmethod
    async def get_settings(self, group_id: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get settings for a group."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def update_settings(self, group_id: int, settings: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        """Update settings for a group."""
        pass
